description: Catalog of premium micro-interactions and motion choreography for TAC Express. Use when adding hover, focus, press, state-change, scroll, or sequencing animations to any component. Trigger on "add a hover effect", "make this feel responsive", "animate this", "the click feels dead", "polish the interaction", "premium feel", "feels static". Maps every motion to the v6 vocabulary (instant / smooth / expressive) and the Violet Grid easing tokens. Always honors prefers-reduced-motion.
